description: Marketplace-level CTR for a single period from monetize_merchant_facts: total ad clicks, impressions, click-through rate (clicks*100/impressions), and marketplace-currency spend, as one ungrouped row for the whole marketplace. Optionally scoped to specific merchants via a merchant filter.

clicks.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN mmf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN mmf.clicks ELSE 0 END), 0)
clicks.description: Total ad clicks for the marketplace over the period.

impressions.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN mmf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN mmf.impressions ELSE 0 END), 0)
impressions.description: Total ad impressions for the marketplace over the period.

ctr.selector: COALESCE(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN mmf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN mmf.clicks ELSE 0 END) * 100, SUM(CASE WHEN mmf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN mmf.impressions ELSE 0 END)), 0)
ctr.description: Click-through rate = clicks * 100 / impressions for the marketplace over the period (0 when impressions = 0).

spend.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN mmf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN mmf.cost ELSE 0 END), 0)
spend.description: Total ad spend for the marketplace over the period, in the marketplace currency.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __METRICS__ FROM reporting.monetize_merchant_facts AS mmf WHERE mmf.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND mmf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND __FILTER__;
